standard.coverage: Standard counties -- everywhere that is neither inside the Portland urban growth boundary nor one of the 18 designated non-urban counties.
standard.note: ORS 653.025: THREE geographic rates, adjusted every July 1 by CPI. Oregon's step date is July 1, so a January-only refresh cycle carries stale Oregon rates for half the year.

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips. Oregon has never allowed a tip credit, at any of its three rates.

variants.label: Portland metro (inside the urban growth boundary)
variants.test: Work performed inside the Portland metropolitan urban growth boundary. ORS 653.025 sets this at $1.25 above the standard rate.

variants.label: Non-urban counties
variants.test: Baker, Coos, Crook, Curry, Douglas, Gilliam, Grant, Harney, Jefferson, Klamath, Lake, Malheur, Morrow, Sherman, Umatilla, Union, Wallowa and Wheeler counties. $1.00 below the standard rate.

knownGaps: Oregon's three rates are geographic but are set by STATE law, not by local ordinance -- they are variants of the state rate here, not entries in local/.
